Join: meet.oakridge/cobalt-retro | Dial-in +1 555 0142, PIN 88213#"},{"spec_id":"spec_0483","text":"Bluebridge site closure: what it means for your team (live Q&A)
Tuesday, April 9 · 11:00 – 11:30am
Google Meet: meet.google.com/lwg-bbsc-qna
Join by phone: +1 555-0199 PIN: 402 117#

Organizer: Delia
19 guests: Bluebridge claims & underwriting staff, Marcus Thorne, Andre Carvalho, Kavya Jaramillo

Description:
I'm sorry for the short notice, and I'm sorry this is landing in your calendar before you've heard it from me in person. Starting June 1, the Bluebridge site will consolidate into the downtown office. I know that's a lot to absorb, and I didn't want anyone reading it in a memo first.

This is a live session because you'll have questions we can only answer together, and I'd rather take them directly than let rumors fill the gap.

Agenda:
• 11:00 – What's changing and the timeline (Delia, 5 min)
• 11:05 – Commute support, hybrid options, parking (Kavya Jaramillo, HR, 5 min)
• 11:10 – How claims queues and client calls will be covered during the move (Marcus Thorne, 5 min)
• 11:15 – Open Q&A, anything at all (Andre Carvalho and me, 15 min)

If you can't make it, please tell me and I'll set up a one-on-one. Nobody should be left guessing. Cameras are optional. If you'd prefer to ask anonymously, there's a form linked in the chat.

Again, apologies for the timing. Thank you for bearing with me.

Delia"},{"spec_id":"spec_0484","text":"All, passing this along from Oskar's office. I know an hour is a big ask with census where it is, but this one's worth showing up for, in person if you can swing it. Last time folks said they found out about the Ashforge changes from the parking lot gossip before they heard it from us, and that's on us. This is your shot to tell leadership straight what's working and what isn't. Charge nurses, please work out coverage among yourselves so floor staff can come. If you truly can't leave the unit, the stream link's below, but questions from the room get answered first.

Thanks, y'all.
Kenji
